SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY MAY PARTICIPATE FROM THE COUNCIL CHAMBER, 18125 BLOOMFIELD AVE OR VIA TELECONFERENCE IN COMPLIANCE WITH STATE OF CA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20, VIA ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 833 1985 9486
* THE CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER REMAINS CLOSED TO THE PUBLIC *
INSTRUCTIONS FOR PUBLIC PARTICIPATION IN THE MEETING VIA ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS,
MEETING ID # 833 1985 9486, ARE LISTED BELOW
MONDAY - NOVEMBER 23, 2020 -
07:00 P.M.
City Council Chamber
*COVID-19 NOTICE*
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, the City Council Chamber remains closed to the public. Consistent with State of California Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the Los Angeles County Health Officer Order the Cerritos City Council may be participating in this meeting from the City Council Chamber and/or authorized teleconference. Public participation in the meeting will be facilitated through the methods as described below.
Agenda Materials:
The agenda and agenda packet related to items on this agenda are available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet will be made available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION:
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on Cerritos TV3, or by connecting to the Zoom meeting described below.
Public Comments:
Members of the public may provide public comment through the following methods:
Email: Members of the public may provide public comment by submitting an email to city_clerk@cerritos.us by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the meeting date and agenda item number for which you would like to provide comment in the subject line of the email. The public comment will be distributed to all members of the City Council. During the meeting your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference Participation: You may provide audio public comment by connecting to the teleconference meeting online or by telephone/mobile call (please select only one method). Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time on the agenda. You must be available to provide comment at the time you are called upon to speak. If you are not planning on providing public comment we encourage you to observe the meeting via livestream or on Cerritos TV3 to allow staff to more effectively manage the number of teleconference connections.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83319859486
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: (669) 900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 833 1985 9486
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations:
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD MONDAY,
NOVEMBER 23, 2020, 7:00 P.M., IN HYBRID MODE FROM THE COUNCIL CHAMBER,
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA AND VIA TELECONFERENCE AS
AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20,
VIA ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 833 1985 9486

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Brenda Cabrera, Assistant City Clerk.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Naresh Solanki.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Bruce Barrows
  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Chuong Vo
  Mayor/Chair Naresh Solanki

5.  Presentations/Appointments

  CLOSED SESSION REPORT

  Mark Steres, City Attorney, provided the following report from the November 12, 2020
  City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Closed Session:

  The City Council met in Closed Session to discuss Items 12A and 12B as listed on the
  November 12, 2020 agenda:

  12A. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(4) (COUNCIL)
  Number of cases: One (1)

  12B. PUBLIC EMPLOYMENT
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957(b) (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Attorney

  With regard to Item 12A, the City Council discussed potential litigation regarding the
  West Santa Ana Branch Transit Project and no reportable action was taken. With regard
  to Item 12B, the City Council discussed the City Attorney position and no reportable
  action was taken.

  This concluded the City Attorney’s report from the November 12, 2020 City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting.
 City of Cerritos  November 23, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 5

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Noting there were no individuals who provided written correspondence or elected to
  speak, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of October 22,
  2020 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Barrows, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of October 22, 2020
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of November
  12, 2020 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Barrows, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of November 12, 2020
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (4 – 0, 1 abstention) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  Barrows

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands

7B.1. Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated November 23, 2020
  (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Barrows, to approve the Register of
  Demands, as follows:

  City of Cerritos  11/23/2020  $ 5,832,974.63 (COUNCIL)

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  November 23, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 5

8.  Public Hearings

  None.

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of an informational update on the City's response to the
  COVID-19 local emergency (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Annie Hylton, City Librarian & Marketing Manager. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.

  CONSENSUS (Yokoyama): Directed the City Manager to monitor and report back to
  the City Council the outcome of the City of La Mirada Special Meeting scheduled for
  November 24, 2020 to consider a resolution opposing the Los Angeles County Health
  Officer Order precluding outdoor dining operations.

  There was no further action taken on this item.

9B.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVING APPLICATION(S) FOR PER
  CAPITA GRANT FUNDS (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Ana Tenorio, Management Analyst. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Yokoyama, and seconded by Hu, to waive full reading of
  and adopt Resolution No. 2020-32, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF
  THE CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVING APPLICATION(S) FOR PER CAPITA GRANT
  FUNDS (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9C.  Review and consideration of an assignment of the agreement for financial audit services
  with White, Nelson, Diehl, Evans, LLP (WNDE), relating to the acquisition of WNDE by
  Clifton, Larson, Allen, LLP (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  A staff report was given by Ryan Carey, Finance Manager. A PowerPoint presentation
  was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.
 City of Cerritos  November 23, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 4 of 5

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9C.  (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Vo, to authorize the Mayor/Chair or
  his designee to execute the Addendum to Agreement for Financial Audit Services with
  White, Nelson, Diehl, Evans, LLP, confirming the City’s written consent to the
  assignment of the agreement and the name change of the service provider from White,
  Nelson, Diehl, Evans, LLP to Clifton Larson Allen LLP (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation.

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or
  Federal legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

  None.

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings

  Reports were provided by Councilmember Yokoyama, Barrows and Mayor Solanki.

  CONSENSUS (Barrows): Directed the City Manager to place a report on a future
  meeting agenda to consider placing a 15 to 16 foot artwork piece in the Cerritos Library
  (Bloomfield side of the first floor), review artwork pieces by previously contracted artist
  Dale Chihuly, and utilize available funds in the Art in Public Places fund to purchase the
  artwork.

12.  Closed Session

  City Attorney Mark Steres announced the City Council would recess to Closed Session to
  discuss the items listed on the Closed Session agenda. An announcement regarding any
  reportable action resulting from the Closed Session will be made at the next regular
  meeting.

12A.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(4) (COUNCIL)
  Number of cases: One (1)

12B.  PUBLIC EMPLOYMENT
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957(b) (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Attorney
 City of Cerritos  November 23, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 5 of 5

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 9:30 p.m.

  /s/Vida Barone
  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary
